Problem Statement:
Jack becomes adventurous suddenly and decides to play the game of "array" jumping .In this game he will be given an arrray A of N integers. When Jack is at a position i in the Array A (1<=i<=N , we use 1-based indexing here) , he can jump to any position A[i] - this is counted as one jump.Find the minimum number of moves that is required for Jack to reach the end of the array- index N from the index 1.
input_spec: The first line contains a single integer N denoting the number of positions in the arrayThe next line contains N integers as described in the problem statement
output_spec: Output a single integer : the minimum number of jumps required to reach the end of the array
